title: The Vanishing of Eilean Mòr
hook: In December 1900, three lighthouse keepers vanished from a remote Scottish island. They left behind a half-eaten meal, an overturned chair, and a final, impossible log entry.

scenes.narration: Twenty miles off the bleak coast of Scotland lie the Flannan Isles. On a freezing night in December 1900, a passing steamship noticed something terrifying: the powerful light atop the remote isle of Eilean Mòr had gone completely dark.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic dark aerial shot of a jagged, storm-swept island in the ocean, a solitary stone lighthouse standing dark against violent waves.

scenes.narration: When a relief vessel reached the island days later, no one answered the signal blasts. The main entrance was locked. Inside, time seemed frozen. The clock had stopped, a cold meal sat untouched on the table, and a single chair was knocked over on its side.
scenes.visual_prompt: Slow, eerie camera movement pushing through a heavy wooden door into a dusty, abandoned 1900s interior, showing cold copper pots and an overturned chair.

scenes.narration: Even stranger were the logbook entries. The keeper wrote of a monstrous storm that brought veteran men to tears, praying for salvation. Yet weather reports from the mainland confirmed the skies had been calm and clear all week.
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of a weather-worn, leather-bound logbook resting on a wooden desk, candle light flickering over handwritten cursive script.

scenes.narration: The final entry simply read: 'God is over all.' Three experienced men vanished into thin air, leaving no trace, no bodies, and a mystery that the Atlantic ocean refuses to yield.
scenes.visual_prompt: Atmospheric high-altitude drone shot slowly rising above the lonely lighthouse on a towering cliff edge as thick sea fog swallows the island whole.
